p: it is indeed so; … But … why do I … “The wife and her children shall be her master’s”?

it is indeed so; this source also teaches the halakha that the offspring of a maidservant is like her. The Gemara asks: But if so, why do I need the verse “The wife and her children shall be her master’s”?
